skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button.
If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will attack normally.
If the charge has finished, you will unleash a different attack.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

Not Charged:
A long-range charge attack with a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked.
Damage increases when your HP is below a certain amount.

Charged:
Increases own ATK.
After that, unleashes a long-range charge attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked.
Damage increases when your HP is below a certain amount.
skills.name: Thunder Bagua

skills.detail:
Skill 2 changes to "I Will Protect You!! (While Capturing Treasure)" while you are capturing Treasure.
After using "I Will Protect You!! (While Capturing Treasure)", you will stop capturing Treasure and Skill 2 will transform back into "I Will Protect You!!".

When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, increases own DEF.
After that, unleashes a long-range area attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked and a DEF debuff.
Damage increases when your HP is below a certain amount.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, deals a long-range area attack with a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked and a DEF debuff.
Damage increases when your HP is below a certain amount.

Become temporarily invincible after use.
skills.name: I Will Protect You!!
